'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[2021 Taliban offensive]]
****The [[Taliban]] proposes a three month ceasefire to the [[Afghan government]] in exchange for the release of 7,000 captured fighters. Nader Nadery, an Afghan government negotiator, says that it is a "big demand" and that it will be evaluated. This move comes after major territorial gains by the insurgent group. The Taliban also demands that they be removed from a [[United Nations]] [[blacklist]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-57848522 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 European floods]]
**Severe floods occur in western [[Germany]], killing 59 people. Eleven more people are also killed in floods in [[Belgium]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-57846200 (BBC News)]
*At least six people are killed during heavy rains in [[Rize]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/gdpr-consent/?next_url=https%3a%2f%2fwww.washingtonpost.com%2fworld%2f2-dead-6-missing-in-floods-landslides-in-northeast-turkey%2f2021%2f07%2f15%2f9e1200ee-e54c-11eb-88c5-4fd6382c47cb_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Indonesia]]
*****The [[National Agency of Drug and Food Control of Indonesia|Food and Drug Authority]] grants an emergency use authorization for the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20210715145336-20-668159/bpom-terbitkan-izin-penggunaan-darurat-vaksin-covid-19-pfizer (CNN Indonesia)]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 56,757 new cases of [[COVID-19]], thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2.72 million. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5644616/update-lengkap-corona-ri-15-juli-rekor-56757-kasus-baru-19049-sembuh (detikNews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 13,215 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 880,782. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-malaysia-record-13215-lockdown-mco-klang-valley-testing-15225440 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Sri Lanka]]
*****[[Sri Lanka]] reports a new single-day record of 384,763 [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] doses administered. [http://www.adaderana.lk/news/75421/covid-19-new-record-for-highest-vaccine-administrations-in-a-day (Adaderana)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record 98 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 3,032. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2149111/record-98-covid-deaths-9-186-new-cases (''Bangkok Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Vietnam]]
*****The [[Ministry of Health (Vietnam)|Ministry of Health]] issues an emergency use authorization for the [[Janssen COVID-19 vaccine]], becoming the sixth vaccine to be approved in [[Vietnam]]. [https://m.timesofindia.com/world/rest-of-world/vietnam-approves-johnson-johnsons-covid-19-vaccine-as-daily-cases-hit-record/amp_articleshow/84442699.cms (''The Times of India'')]
****Vietnam surpasses 40,000 cases of COVID-19 after a record 3,416 cases are reported in the past 24 hours. [https://vietnamnews.vn/society/993765/69-covid-19-deaths-announced-as-caseload-tops-40000-with-record-daily-increase.html (Viet Nam News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 791 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 146,069. [https://armenpress.am/eng/news/1058256/ (Armenpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports 48,553 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of new cases since January 15. [https://www.itv.com/news/2021-07-15/uk-covid-cases-rise-by-almost-50000-in-one-day-highest-increase-since-january-15 (ITV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****A [[Food and Drug Administration]] official says that a [[vaccine]] for children under the age of 12 years is expected to be approved by midwinter. [https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/vaccines-kids-under-age-12-expected-mid-winter-fda-official-n1274057 (NBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
****[[Los Angeles County, California|Los Angeles County]] will restore their [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|indoor mask mandate]] amid the spread of the [[SARS-CoV-2 lineage B.1.617|Lineage B.1.617]] [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta variant]]. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/los-angeles-county-to-restore-indoor-mask-mandate-for-all-01626387722 (MarketWatch)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Louisiana]]
****Amidst a rise of cases in [[Louisiana]], [[Governor of Louisiana|Governor]] [[John Bel Edwards]] reports that 50% of adults in the state have received a dose of the vaccine. [https://www.katc.com/news/covering-louisiana/edwards-reports-50-of-louisiana-adults-now-have-at-least-one-covid-vaccine-shot (KATC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maryland]]
****[[Governor of Maryland|Maryland Governor]] [[Larry Hogan]] announces that [[Maryland|the state]] has administered seven million doses of the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.wboc.com/story/44317388/vaccine-milestone-md-surpasses-7m-vaccinations-administered (WBOC-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Missouri]]
****The [[Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services]] issues a hotspot advisory in several counties in southwest [[Missouri]] amid an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases in the state. [https://fox4kc.com/news/state-officials-issue-hotspot-advisory-in-southwest-missouri-due-to-rising-covid-19-cases/ (WDAF-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mauritius]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[Mauritius]] reopens its borders to [[vaccinate]]d tourists after being closed for 16 months as part of a two-phase strategy to attract tourists in order to revive the economy from the impact of the [[pandemic]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-07-15/mauritius-reopens-borders-to-vaccinated-tourists-after-16-months?sref=Ycj954CZ (Bloomberg)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Papua New Guinea]]
***[[Papua New Guinea]] reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant in a 65-year-old Filipino who is the captain of a cargo ship which departed from [[Indonesia]] on June 26 and arrived in the country almost two weeks later. [https://www.sbs.com.au/news/papua-new-guinea-records-first-covid-19-case-of-highly-contagious-delta-variant (SBS)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Rwanda]]
***The [[Rwandan government]] announces a lockdown in its capital [[Kigali]] and eight other districts from July 17 in an attempt to curb the increase in cases. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/rwanda-s-capital-to-enter-lockdown-from-july-17-amid-covid-surge/2304859 (Anadolou Agency)]
'''International relations'''
*[[Cuba–United States relations]]
**[[United States involvement in regime change in Latin America]]
***[[Governor of Florida|Florida Governor]] [[Ron DeSantis]] urges the [[Cuban Revolutionary Armed Forces|Cuban military]] to stage a [[Coup d'état|coup]] in [[Cuba]]. He also urges the [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] to "restore internet access to [[Cuba]]". [https://www.tampabay.com/news/florida-politics/2021/07/15/desantis-urges-cuban-military-to-overthrow-government/ (''Tampa Bay Times'')]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] calls Cuba a "failed state" and denounces [[communism]] as a "failed system". He also said the [[United States]] is looking into ways to "restoring internet access in Cuba". [https://www.cnn.com/2021/07/15/politics/cuba-communism-biden/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Hungary]], [[LGBT rights in Poland]]
**The [[European Commission]] launches legal challenges against [[Hungary]] and parts of [[Poland]] due to their anti-[[LGBT]]+ laws. The Commission adds that "Europe will never allow parts of our society to be stigmatized". [https://www.dw.com/en/eu-sues-hungary-and-poland-over-lgbtq-discrimination/a-58272160 (DW)]
*[[Killing of Peter R. de Vries]]
**[[Dutch people|Dutch]] crime reporter [[Peter R. de Vries]] dies in an [[Amsterdam]] hospital from complications of gunshot wounds. De Vries had been shot five times outside of an Amsterdam TV studio nine days earlier. Two of the suspects in the shooting are in custody. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/15/hold-obit-fearless-dutch-crime-journalist-dies-after-being-shot (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Cuban protests]]
**[[Cuban Americans]] gather at the [[Florida State Capitol]] in solidarity with protesters in [[Cuba]]. [https://www.wctv.tv/2021/07/15/cuban-americans-rally-freedom-florida-capitol/ (WCTV)]
*[[Prime Minister of Lebanon|Interim Prime Minister of Lebanon]] [[Saad Hariri]] resigns after both failing to form a new government in the past eight months and reaching an impasse with [[President of Lebanon|President]] [[Michel Aoun]] on adopting some constitutional amendments. Supporters of Hariri and his party [[Future Movement]] subsequently protest in [[Beirut]], where they clashed with riot police, and blocked roads in  [[Tripoli, Lebanon|Tripoli]] and [[Tyre, Lebanon|Tyre]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/15/lebanon-pm-designate-saad-hariri-resigns-as-crisis-escalates (Al Jazeera)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Israeli football league system|Israeli football club]] [[Beitar Jerusalem F.C.]] cancels a planned match with [[FC Barcelona]] after the latter refused to hold the match in [[Jerusalem]], following a complaint sent by the [[Palestinian Football Association]] earlier this month. The planned location of the match would have been in [[Malha]], which was a [[Palestinians|Palestinian Arab]] village prior to the establishment of [[Israel]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/15/israeli-club-calls-off-match-with-barcelona-over-jerusalem (Al Jazeera)]
